# nb-studio preview

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## preview down

Destroy an issue’s previews

For whoever may edit the issue. Destroys every preview App of the issue’s pull requests with its data, or the ones `appId` names (a preview’s App, or the App previewed); a pull request linked to other issues loses them there too, until its next head. Answers the issue’s previews, `meta.message` saying what went. An agent’s run on an issue may leave `issueId` out for its own issue.

```bash
nb-studio preview down
```

| Flag      | Type    | Description                                                                          |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--issue` | string  | The issue, by identifier (PM-12) or id; in a run on an issue, that issue by default. |
| `--app`   | string  | The preview’s own App, or the App it previews, when the issue has several previews.  |
| `--yes`   | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Destroy these previews and their data?”                     |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `studio.previews/manage`.

**Request:** `POST /api/previews/down` (`previewsDestroyIssuePreviews`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio preview down --yes
nb-studio preview down --issue PM-12 --app web
```

## preview list

List live previews

The live previews of the pull requests linked to issues the caller may see, each with the first such issue, of one project when `projectId` is given. A bounded list; never a first administrator.

```bash
nb-studio preview list
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description |
| ----------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `--project` | string |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `identifier`, `appId`, `status`, `runtime.state`, `url`, `deployedSha`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/previews` (`previewsListPreviews`)

## preview logs

Read a preview App’s log

For whoever sees the issue: one bounded chunk of the log of a live preview of its pull requests (`appId` names the preview’s App, or the App it previews, when there are several). Read on with `pageToken` set to the previous `meta.nextPageToken`. An agent’s run on an issue may leave `issueId` out for its own issue.

```bash
nb-studio preview logs
```

| Flag           | Type   | Description                                                                          |
| -------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--issue`      | string | The issue, by identifier (PM-12) or id; in a run on an issue, that issue by default. |
| `--app`        | string | The preview’s own App, or the App it previews, when the issue has several previews.  |
| `--page-token` | string | Read on from a previous `meta.nextPageToken`.                                        |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `time`, `level`, `msg`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `studio.previews/manage`.

**Request:** `GET /api/previews/logs` (`previewsReadPreviewLogs`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio preview logs
nb-studio preview logs --issue PM-12 --app web
```

## preview retry

Deploy a preview again

For whoever may edit the issue. Deploys the build of the preview’s head again (`appId` is the preview’s App, or the App previewed when the issue has one preview of it); answers the issue’s previews.

```bash
nb-studio preview retry <issue> <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |
| `app`    |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/previews/retry` (`previewsRetryPreview`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio preview retry PM-12 web
```

## preview status

Read an issue’s previews

For whoever sees the issue: the previews of its linked pull requests, one per pull request and App previewed, each with its address, state, the head it follows and the one it runs, and the head’s build as CI reported it. The first administrator only for whoever may edit the issue, and its password only to a person asking with `adminPassword=true`. An agent’s run on an issue may leave `issueId` out for its own issue.

```bash
nb-studio preview status
```

| Flag      | Type   | Description                                                                          |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--issue` | string | The issue, by identifier (PM-12) or id; in a run on an issue, that issue by default. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/previews/status` (`previewsGetIssuePreviews`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio preview status
nb-studio preview status --issue PM-12
```
